sections.heading: Implementation Details.
sections.text: We trained Logistic Regression probes using a strict split on the Malicious and Benign datasets: 40 samples for training, 10 for validation, and 50 held-out samples reserved for the refusal erasure and injection experiments. We extracted three directions: 𝐯 R \mathbf{v}_{R} using double-difference vectors; 𝐯 H \mathbf{v}_{H} using masked states; a baseline anchor ( 𝐡 CB − 𝐡 MB \mathbf{h}_{\text{CB}}-\mathbf{h}_{\text{MB}} ) for steering alignment. Crucially, the AmbiguityBench dataset (N=100) was excluded from all training processes.
